WFP/UNICEF Conflict prevention & child protection in Cabo Delgado

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the programme is to support children and young people to participate in forging peace and development in their communities.
The joint programme aims to empower children and young people impacted by crisis to take an active role in their communities by promoting sustainable development, forging peace, social cohesion and transformation.
The programme has three main components and 7 outputs contributing to the overall objective as follows:
Outcome 1 Equitable access and participation in basic social services and ensured for children's learning and protection
Output 1.1. School-aged children and adolescents in the targeted areas, especially the most vulnerable, have access to inclusive and equitable quality education through formal and non-formal educational services in a safe, healthy and gender sensitive environment that promotes learning outcomes.
Output 1.2. The most vulnerable children and adolescents have increased access to social services.
Outcome 2 - Social cohesion for peaceful communities is strengthened through integrated systems for reintegration of children formerly associated with armed groups
Output 2.1. Enhanced social cohesion and peacebuilding skills among adolescents and youth in target communities.
Output 2.2. Improved child protection and community resilience through integrated prevention, mental health and psychosocial support (MHPSS), reintegration, and referral mechanisms, with heightened collaboration between communities, security sectors, and service providers.
Outcome 3 - Food security and resilience to climate and socio-economic shocks for vulnerable individuals are strengthened
Output 3.1. Ecosystems restoration and Cash-for-Work (CfW) Models are enhanced through capacity building and Nature-based Solutions (NbSs) on-ground implementation.
Output 3.2. Climate-resilient agriculture and non-agriculture-based livelihood are enhanced through the introduction of water-energy-food ecosystem nexus, climate smart food systems and provision of diversified technical skills addressing the needs of smallholder farmers and young adults.
Output 3.3. Fishery production is enhanced through sustainable fishing practices and access to necessary support services.

WFP and UNICEF will implement a three year programmed titled "Supporting children and young people to participate in sustainable development, peacebuilding, social cohesion and transformation in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique". The joint programme aims to empower children and young people impacted by crises to take an active role in their communities by promoting sustainable development, forging peace, social cohesion and transformation. The programme has three main components that contribute to the overall objective: 1. Equitable access and participation in basic social services are ensured for children’s learning and protection 2. Social cohesion for peaceful communities is strengthened through integrated systems for reintegration of children formerly associated with armed groups 3. Food security and resilience to climate and socio-economic shocks for vulnerable individuals are strengthened

WFP och UNICEF ska under en treårsperiod tillsammans genomföra programmet "Supporting children and young people to participate in sustainable development, peacebuilding, social cohesion and transformation in Cabo Delgado, Mozambique". Det gemensamma programmet syftar till att ge barn och ungdomar som drabbats av kriser möjlighet att spela en aktiv roll i sina samhällen genom att främja hållbar utveckling, fred, social sammanhållning och bidra till positiv förändring. Programmet har tre huvudkomponenter som bidrar till det övergripande målet: 1. Säkerställa rättvis tillgång till, och deltagande i, grundläggande sociala tjänster för barns lärande och skydd 2. Stärka den sociala sammanhållningen för fredliga samhällen genom integrerade system för återintegrering av barn som tidigare varit associerade med väpnade grupper 3. Stärka livsmedelstryggheten och förbättra motståndskraften mot klimatrelaterade- och socioekonomiska chocker
